axes_source: Read from data/brands/vercel.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #171717 and the canvas #FFFFFF; contrast from the ink #171717 on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #171717; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 0, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 64px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
